comment: In case I want to compare my agent to Mobile-Agent-E, this benchmark, follows their format, which can be found here: https://github.com/X-PLUG/MobileAgent/tree/main/Mobile-Agent-E/data/Mobile-Eval-E The tasks are either from me or from AndroidArena: https://github.com/AndroidArenaAgent/AndroidArena/tree/main/tasks (tasks: 7, 9, 16, 18) Those test cases were edited.

tasks.instruction: Change settings so that the battery percentage is shown in the status bar.
rubrics: Battery percentage visible in the status bar.
human_reference_operations: swipe up to open the app drawer

tasks.instruction: Change settings so that the battery percentage is not shown in the status bar.
rubrics: Battery percentage not visible in the status bar.
human_reference_operations: swipe up to open the app drawer

tasks.instruction: Change the screen brightness level to 0%
human_reference_operations: swipe up to open the app drawer

tasks.instruction: Change the screen brightness level to 100%
human_reference_operations: swipe up to open the app drawer

tasks.instruction: In Keep Notes create a new note with the content 'I love ice cream.' and the title 'ice cream'.
rubrics: Create a new note with the content 'I love ice cream.' and the title 'ice cream'.
human_reference_operations: swipe up to open the app drawer

tasks.instruction: In Keep Notes create a copy of the note with the content 'I love ice cream.' and the title 'ice cream'.
rubrics: Create a new note with the content 'I love ice cream.' and the title 'ice cream'.
human_reference_operations: swipe up to open the app drawer

tasks.instruction: In Keep Notes delete all notes with the content 'I love ice cream.' and the title 'ice cream'.
rubrics: Delete all notes with the content 'I love ice cream.' and the title 'ice cream'.
human_reference_operations: swipe up to open the app drawer

tasks.instruction: Create a new contact with the first name 'John', last name 'Smith', email address 'john@example.com', and phone number '010-123456' in Contacts. Do not forget to save the new contact.
rubrics: Created and saved a new contact with the first name 'John', last name 'Smith', phone number '010-123456', and email address 'john@example.com' in Contacts.
human_reference_operations: tap on the blue phone icon

tasks.instruction: Edit the contact 'John Smith': Change his first name to 'Johnathan'. Save the change.
rubrics: Changed and saved contact 'John Smith' to 'Johnathan Smith'
human_reference_operations: tap on the blue phone icon

tasks.instruction: Add the existing label 'Friend' to 'Johnathan Smith' in Contacts. Save the change.
human_reference_operations: tap on the blue phone icon

tasks.instruction: Delete 'Johnathan Smith' from Contacts.
human_reference_operations: tap on the blue phone icon

tasks.instruction: Send an email to lukas.hohl@tum.de with the subject 'Test' and the content 'Greetings! This is a test!'
rubrics: E-mail successfully sent to lukas.hohl@tum.de with the subject 'Test' and the content 'Greetings! This is a test!'
human_reference_operations: swipe up to open the app drawer
tap the arrow icon to send

tasks.instruction: Open 'tageschau.de' with Chrome. Open the first article on the front page and read the article summary, which is the bold text at the beginning of the article. Using the 'Gmail' app, write an e-mail containing the article's summary to lukas.hohl@tum.de with the subject 'Summary'.
human_reference_operations: swipe up to open the app drawer
type the text of the summary
tap the arrow icon to send

tasks.instruction: Delete all emails in 'Sent'.'

swipe up to open the app drawer

tasks.instruction: Go to Google Scholar. Search for 'LLM papers' using Google Scholar. Create a Note in KeepNotes that as content includes the titles of the first four papers about LLMs you find on Google Scholar.
rubrics: Created note with the 4 paper titles. This still counts as finished even if the formatting is not perfect.
